meta.title: Add Context Caching Support
meta.body_summary: Add context caching support via LiteLLM cache_control, introducing cache_enabled and cache_ttl parameters to the LLM class, updating documentation, and adding basic tests.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added context caching; an AI-generated review provided extensive feedback; Devin partially addressed it; PR closed by bot after 7 days inactivity with no human merge decision.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 268 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small feature addition by absolute volume. The PR lacked performance evidence and human maintainer approval; closure is consistent with insufficient evidence and process inactivity.

review_details.concern_detail: An AI-generated review from joaomdmoura identified missing TTL validation, absence of cache management methods, insufficient tests, and documentation gaps.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve performance and reduce costs by caching parts of prompts unchanged across API calls.
review_details.rejection_signals: AI-generated review suggested multiple improvements; Devin partially implemented some but PR stagnated and was auto-closed for inactivity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding context caching requires handling provider‑specific cache_control semantics across multiple LLM APIs; Devin delivered an initial implementation but left gaps in validation and cache management, and the process stalled after partial response to AI feedback.

detection_detail.code_reading: Review was entirely generated by a crew of AI agents; no evidence of human code‑reading or manual testing.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler, or numeric performance claim; only narrative statements about cost and performance improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by bot after 7 days of inactivity, with feedback partially addressed but no final human approval.

core_change_summary.description: Added cache_enabled and cache_ttl parameters to LLM class; modified LLM.call() to include LiteLLM cache_control when enabled; added cache management stubs in follow-up commit; updated README with caching docs and provider notes; added basic unit tests.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added caching support, README updates, and test file.
Second commit: addressed AI feedback—added TTL validation, cache management method stubs, and enhanced documentation.
